text: 亚太市场午后集体拉升，分析人士认为，两则利好消息，刺激了这波上涨：一是韩国稳市，二是A股ETF再现大手笔买入。从A股的角度来看，来自兴证金工的数据显示，7月13日三大指数的核心ETF出现较大规模净流入，其中，沪深300ETF流入84.93亿元；中证500ETF流入73.52亿元；中证1000ETF大幅增加119.23亿元。这可能意味着，当下这个点位也是大资金认可的点位。（券商中国）
text_en: Asia-Pacific markets rallied collectively in the afternoon. Analysts attribute the surge to two positive news: South Korea's market stabilization and large-scale buying of A-share ETFs. From an A-share perspective, data from Industrial Securities Quantitative Research shows that on July 13, core ETFs tracking three major indices saw significant net inflows, with CSI 300 ETFs receiving 8.493 billion yuan, CSI 500 ETFs 7.352 billion yuan, and CSI 1000 ETFs surging by 11.923 billion yuan. This may indicate that the current levels are recognized by major capital. (Securities China)
